operations.command:
set -ex
P=$(blkid -t TYPE=crypto_LUKS -o device | head -1)
test -n "$P"
printf %s "$P" > /var/tmp/e2e-luks
rm -f /var/tmp/e2e-header-before.img
cryptsetup luksHeaderBackup "$P" --header-backup-file /var/tmp/e2e-header-before.img
cryptsetup luksDump "$P" | sed -n '/^Keyslots:/,/^Tokens:/p' > /var/tmp/e2e-keyslots-before
grep -F luks2 /var/tmp/e2e-keyslots-before
for wrong in wrong-passphrase another-wrong-one; do if printf %s "$wrong" | cryptsetup open --test-passphrase "$P"; then exit 1; fi; done
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id > /var/tmp/e2e-wrong-boot
sync
printf header-recorded

set -ex
P=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-luks)
test "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)" != "$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-wrong-boot)"
cryptsetup status root | grep -F 'is active'
rm -f /var/tmp/e2e-header-after.img
cryptsetup luksHeaderBackup "$P" --header-backup-file /var/tmp/e2e-header-after.img
cmp /var/tmp/e2e-header-before.img /var/tmp/e2e-header-after.img
cryptsetup luksDump "$P" | sed -n '/^Keyslots:/,/^Tokens:/p' | cmp - /var/tmp/e2e-keyslots-before
printf %s testpass123 | cryptsetup open --test-passphrase "$P"
for wrong in wrong-passphrase another-wrong-one; do if printf %s "$wrong" | cryptsetup open --test-passphrase "$P"; then exit 1; fi; done
rm -f /var/tmp/e2e-header-before.img /var/tmp/e2e-header-after.img
printf wrong-passphrases-changed-nothing
